description: AKS GPU demand, Karpenter capacity, on-demand/spot split, and Istio service traffic overview for the azure-gpu-demo workload model.

targets.expr: sum((max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container, deployment) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod",resource=~"nvidia_com_gpu|nvidia.com/gpu"}) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, replicaset) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod",owner_kind="replicaset"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) * on (cluster, namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) max by (cluster, namespace, replicaset, deployment) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",owner_kind="deployment",owner_name=~"$deployment"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")))) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod",phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1) * on (cluster, namespace, deployment) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, deployment) ((label_replace(label_replace(max by (cluster, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (istio_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster",reporter="source",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",destination_service_name=~"$service",destination_workload=~"$deployment"}), "namespace", "$1", "destination_workload_namespace", "(.*)"), "deployment", "$1", "destination_workload", "(.*)") * 0) + 1))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Peak Requested GPUs (range)
